# In the Binder

> In the Binder is a free Android app for trading card collectors, currently in beta on Google Play. It scans cards with the phone camera, files them into binders set by set, checks centring before grading (PSA, BGS, CGC limits), reads graded slabs and shows what a collection is worth. It works offline.

- Platform: Android (Google Play beta). iPhone version planned. A free web version at https://inthebinder.com/app/ works on any computer or phone: it opens the app's backup file (collection, value over time, grading picks, centring on a photo) and keeps it in the browser.
- Price: free.
- Card games: Pokémon, plus the English editions of One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Dragon Ball Super Fusion World, Magic: The Gathering and Yu-Gi-Oh!. Each game has its own binders, slabs and sealed product; a game's card list downloads the first time it is opened.
- Pokémon card languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese.
- Scanner: recognises cards by their picture and by printed codes (for example OP01-003, LOB-EN001), and learns from the scans a user confirms. Runs on the phone.
- Privacy: card recognition runs on the phone; photos are not uploaded.
- Independent app, not affiliated with Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK, The Pokémon Company, Bandai, Disney, Ravensburger, Wizards of the Coast or Konami.
- Contact: support@inthebinder.com
